about_the_game:
Even fateful love bound in red silk is doomed to unravel.

The "Paper Bride 4 Bound Love-Soundtrack" has officially released!
This compilation features two of the game's classic original songs, one of which is a lyrical composition.
The WAV file for the theme song "The Way of Love" features 2304kbps bit-rate for high-quality, lossless audio.

When listening to these songs, we hope you look back fondly on the joy and emotions you experienced in the world of Paper Bride. Thank you again for your love and support of the series, and we look forward to meeting again.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 7sp1 or Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core2 Duo E6550 or AMD equivalent or above
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GT440（512M）or AMD Radeon equivalent or above
  • Storage: 47 MB available space
